_description: Traditional-only starting portfolio with an active Roth conversion. Verifies ensureRothConversionAccount auto-creates a receiving Roth account.
_rationale: Age 60. Only Traditional account ($100k). Conversion of $20k at year 0. Without ensureRothConversionAccount, addToType would no-op on Roth deposit. With it, a Roth account is injected and receives the converted funds. rothConversionGross should be 20,000 and the simulation should complete without error.
name: Roth Conversion — Auto-Create Roth Account
